$comment: Service-worker caching policy (read by viteServiceWorker.ts at build time). Predictable by design: the app shell is precached per build, content-hashed /assets/ files (incl. the manifold kernel wasm; the 60 MB OCC kernel is never cached) are cache-first, every other request (server API, live stream, MCP, samples) goes straight to the network. One cache per build; activating a new build deletes the old ones.
